acceptance_repairs.given: A real skipped-Consumer Matrix Case input is submitted to the Toolchain success-evaluation process.
acceptance_repairs.when: The process evaluates that skipped-Consumer case and records its terminal status.
acceptance_repairs.then: The skipped-Consumer case receives a non-success terminal outcome; a success terminal status fails verification.

oracle.observable: The executed success-evaluation result and terminal status for the real skipped-Consumer case.
oracle.expected: The recorded terminal status is non-success.
forbidden: The skipped-Consumer case is reported as successful.

acceptance_repairs.given: An invalid package is submitted to the package-validation operation.
acceptance_repairs.when: The operation evaluates the invalid package and records its validation result and terminal status.
acceptance_repairs.then: The invalid-package validation result has a non-success terminal status; a success terminal status fails verification.

oracle.observable: The recorded package-validation result and terminal status for the invalid package.
oracle.expected: The invalid-package validation result records a non-success terminal status.
forbidden: The invalid package is reported as successful.
